description:
Configure the store's shipping settings for a new launch based in Portland, Oregon. 

1. Go to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Shipping Settings > Origin and set:
   - Country: United States
   - Region/State: Oregon
   - ZIP/Postal Code: 97201
   - City: Portland
   - Street Address: 450 SW Morrison St

2. Go to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Shipping Methods > Flat Rate and set:
   - Enabled: Yes
   - Title: 'Ground Shipping'
   - Method Name: 'Standard Delivery'
   - Price: 7.49
   - Type: Per Order
   - Sort Order: 10

3. Go to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Shipping Methods > Free Shipping and set:
   - Enabled: Yes
   - Minimum Order Amount: 75
   - Sort Order: 5

Save the configuration after making changes. If not logged in, use admin / Admin1234!
